note: Equipment fields of every Weapon, Armor, Ammo, ShadowGear and Card in item_db_*.yml, with ItemDatabase::parseBodyNode's defaults and caps and loadingFinished's fixes. type is the item_db Type. subtype is the W_, AMMO_ or CARD_ value of SubType. location is item_data::equip, the EQP_ bits of Locations; a card's location is where it can be compounded. Items without a valid location are left out, as rAthena makes them IT_ETC. atk, matk (renewal only), def, range, slots, weapon_level, armor_level, min_level and max_level are item_data's atk, matk, def, range, slots, weapon_level, armor_level, elv and elvmax; a missing field is 0, and a missing max_level is MAX_LEVEL (275). refineable is Refineable. view is item_data::look, 1 for shields without one. jobs is item_data::class_base as three decimal strings, from itemdb_jobid2mapid over Jobs; a missing jobs is every job (MAPID_ALL in all three). classes is item_data::class_upper, the ITEMJ_ bits of Classes; a missing classes is ITEMJ_ALL. sex is 0 for female and 1 for male after defaultGender; a missing sex is both. no_equip is item_data's flag.no_equip from item_noequip.txt: the map types where the item's script does not run (1 normal maps, 2 PvP, 4 GvG, 8 battlegrounds, 16 WoE:TE, 32 and up restricted zones).
